readiness.title: Readiness calendar
readiness.hint: The current and the following month with every shift. The colour of a day shows the state of the shift. The current day is specially marked. The times are Europe/Berlin.
readiness.empty: No readiness is planned for this period.
readiness.pageHint: The calendar shows who has the readiness. Below it you find your own shifts.
readiness.pageHintWithoutNames: The calendar shows the readiness shifts. Below it you find your own shifts.
readiness.icalHint: The address of your personal calendar feed.
readiness.icalSubscribe: Enter the address in your calendar app to subscribe to the shifts.

admin.title: On-call plan
admin.hint: Manage pools, duty times, warnings, shift swaps and settings. The weekly planning lives in the readiness view. Times use Europe/Berlin.
admin.sessionNotice: The session has expired. Please sign in again.
admin.forbiddenNotice: The on-call plan needs the oncall.read permission.

pools.title: Pools
pools.hint: A pool is one on-call calendar. Only a pool without shifts can be deleted.
pools.name: Name
pools.noGroup: No group (everyone with the oncall role)
pools.deleteHint: A pool with shifts cannot be deleted.

openShifts.title: Open shifts
openShifts.hint: Shifts that wait for a decision: nobody assigned, not published, not confirmed or declined. A click opens the shift with the actions of the readiness office.

grid.title: Weekly plan
grid.hint: Generate shifts, assign a technician, publish or delete. Every action reloads the plan.
grid.groupMembersHint: This group's members are maintained in the group administration; all active users are offered here.
grid.locked: Confirmed shifts, shifts in a swap and published shifts that already started stay in the history.
grid.summary: {{total}} shifts in this week, {{declined}} declined and {{unfilled}} unstaffed.
grid.reassignHint: The shift was declined — assign another technician.

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.hint: Unstaffed shifts inside the warning window and planned shifts that are not confirmed yet.

swaps.title: Shift swaps
swaps.hint: Open and accepted swap requests. Accepted requests wait for approval.
swaps.approveHint: Only an accepted swap can be approved.

settings.title: On-call settings
settings.hint: The oncall keys of the specification. Empty or invalid values fall back to the default.
settings.defaultPoolHint: Only for ticket offers and the dashboard tile: when a ticket names no pool, this pool is asked. The pool duty times are below.

schedule.title: Duty times per pool
schedule.hint: Every pool has its own plan. A duty block spans several weekdays.
schedule.windowPlan: This pool uses its own duty blocks.
schedule.noWindows: Without duty blocks the continuous plan of the settings applies (week start, start time, duration).
schedule.normalised: Consecutive days with the same duty times form one duty block: the week then holds one shift instead of one shift per day.

myShifts.title: My on-call shifts
myShifts.hint: Your planned and confirmed shifts as well as past shifts. Times use Europe/Berlin.

errors.reasonTooShort: Please enter a reason of at least 5 characters.

errors.session_invalid: The session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: This action needs a permission you do not have.
errors.invalid_request: The input is incomplete or invalid.
errors.oncall_pool_name_taken: This pool name is already taken.
errors.oncall_pool_in_use: The pool still has shifts and cannot be deleted.
errors.oncall_shift_locked: The shift stays in the history: it is confirmed, in a swap or held the readiness.
errors.oncall_invalid_shift_state: The shift cannot be changed in this state — it has no technician.
errors.oncall_default_pool_not_active: The default pool must be active.
errors.oncall_range_too_large: The selected range is too large.
errors.swap_taken: Someone else already accepted the swap.
errors.swap_not_pending: The swap is no longer pending.
errors.swap_not_accepted: The swap has not been accepted yet.
errors.oncall_swap_request_not_found: The swap request was not found.
errors.oncall_decline_reason_required: A reason of 5 to 500 characters is required.
errors.swap_already_open: There is already an open swap request for this shift.
errors.unknown: The action failed. Please try again later.

shiftDetail.title: Shift details
shiftDetail.empty: This shift has no history yet.
shiftDetail.error: The history could not be loaded.
shiftDetail.deleteLocked: The shift is confirmed or in a swap and stays in the history.
shiftDetail.remindLocked: The shift has already started or has no technician.
shiftDetail.lockedState: The shift is confirmed or in a swap and cannot be deleted.
shiftDetail.lockedConfirmed: The shift held the readiness and stays in the history.
shiftDetail.lockedStarted: The published shift has already started and stays in the history.
shiftDetail.lockedTransition: The shift cannot be changed in this state.
